entries.title: Stripe has decided to nuke my entire business
entries.author: yaythefuture
entries.current_title: Stripe has decided to nuke my entire business
entries.excerpt: Saw https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=32261868 from a couple weeks ago and figured I'd share my own story. 3 weeks ago, I woke up to a pissed off customer telling me her payments were broken. My startup uses Stripe Connect to accept payments on behalf of our clients, and when I looked into it, I found that Stripe had decided to deactivate her account. Reason listed: 'Other'. Great. I contact Stripe via chat, and I learn nothing. Frontline support says "we'll look into it."
entries.guide_zh: 创业者称 Stripe 无明确解释停用客户收款账号，危及整个业务。

entries.title: Tell HN: Somebody implemented something I wrote a blog about
entries.author: rexfuzzle
entries.current_title: Tell HN: Somebody implemented something I wrote a blog about
entries.excerpt: So a while ago I wrote about how 2FA was missing a key feature: https://syslog.ravelin.com/2fa-is-missing-a-key-feature-c781... Having not had any feedback on it in a while and the idea not taking off, today somebody messaged me to say that had implemented it in their product. 1. Obviously I think this is great and more secure 2. Tell people about things you do that they played a part it- it might just make their day.
entries.guide_zh: 作者博客提出的双因素认证改进被他人实现，分享想法变成产品的欣喜。

entries.title: Tell HN: Otter.ai bot recording meetings without consent
entries.author: arcticfox
entries.current_title: Tell HN: Otter.ai bot recording meetings without consent
entries.excerpt: I occasionally use Otter.ai to transcribe when I'm multitasking. Recently they made an update, which I carefully opted out of, to automatically join every meeting through my Google Calendar and transcribe it. Screenshots prove I had the feature disabled. The bot proceeded to join two confidential meetings on my behalf and record the whole thing, then email every member an absurd, inaccurate "outline" after. I am not much of a privacy person but I feel completely abused in thi
entries.guide_zh: 发帖者称 Otter.ai 更新后未经明确同意加入并录制会议，表达隐私担忧。
